text:
zara-partner: FYI we noticed a day-bound mismatch: partner reports hourly usage in local TZ (Europe/Zurich) and our ingestion window uses UTC cutoffs. For a few customers this shifted ~1-2 hours of usage into the previous invoice day. sample: {"device":"gw-11","timestamp":"2026-05-02T00:30:00+02:00","sku":"edge-pro","units":10,"entitlement_id":"ent-777"}

leo-eng: Hmm. We ingest timestamps as-is then normalize to UTC for windowing. If partner timestamps include offset, we should be aligning to partner's local billing day only if contract says so. Do we have a per-partner timezone flag?

ani-billing: Most marketplace contracts default to UTC day boundaries, but a few hardware partners requested local-day billing for pilots. This partner thought we honored local-day semantics. Billing showed a 2.7% day-over-day delta for three pilot accounts.

michael-integrations: short-term mitigation: introduce a per-partner ledger-window-mode flag (utc|partner-local). Default remains utc. For partners marked local, transform timestamps into partner TZ before windowing. ETA for feature toggle: 6h.

ops-lead: Marketing question: does this require pausing the joint launch for Zurich pilot? It's small but billing displays could confuse customers.

zara-partner: pilot customers prefer accurate local-day reporting. Partner asks we flip to partner-local for these pilots and re-run the last 48h backfill to shift affected rows. They will provide confirmation email for contract change.

leo-eng: proposed steps:
1) add `partner_window_mode` flag and column in partner metadata (quick toggle)
2) accept historic re-windowing backfill for last 48h when flag enabled
3) mark backfilled rows as `rewindowed` in ledger with audit note to avoid duplicate invoiceable tokens
4) create a reconciler job that detects >0.5% day-delta after rewindow and auto-opens a billing exception if customers disagree

ani-billing: agree but require partner-signed opt-in before we alter ledger windows. Also, backfilled rows should be non-invoiceable until review complete. Proposed SLA: we apply rewindowing within 48h of signed consent and correct invoices within 72h.

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1750 -> partner-daybound-timezone-mismatch (severity: low). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1750

michael-integrations: action items:
- michael: add partner_window_mode toggle and rewindow backfill flow (ETA 6h, backfill job ETA 12h)
- leo: add ledger `rewindowed` flag + audit notes (ETA 6h)
- ani: prepare customer-facing opt-in template and SLA (ETA 3h)
- zara: get partner-signed confirmation (ETA 12h)

zara-partner: partner sent signed opt-in at 2026-05-02T08:20Z. attaching to ticket.

michael-integrations: ran backfill for last 48h; affected rows rewindowed and marked `rewindowed`. Created billing exception for two customers; held invoiceable tokens pending review.

ani-billing: Reviewed exceptions; invoices corrected and emailed to customers. Reconciliation complete within SLA.

ops-lead: Marketing ok to proceed with pilot announcement; include a short note about local-day billing opt-in and contact for invoice questions.

zara-partner: thanks all — closing loop. :white_check_mark:
